intro: Silvervein the Elder is an honored ancestral spirit who appears during the Lunar Festival atop the hills overlooking Thelsamar in Loch Modan. Travelers pay their respects to him to honor the ancient ties among Azeroth's elder peoples. In return for acknowledging his presence and heritage, he bestows his ancestral blessing.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, friend, and offer you this token...
